user.title: Sign in to Changhuxi
user.description: Use the mobile number and password from the Changhuxi app. Devices must already be paired in that app. This unofficial integration uses the vendor cloud; keep other clients for this account closed. Your password is used for sign-in only and is not saved.

captcha.title: Complete the image challenge
captcha.description: Open [the verification image]({captcha_url}), then enter the characters below.

error.invalid_auth: Sign-in was rejected. Check your mobile number and password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the service. Please try again later.
error.no_selection: Select at least one supported purifier.

abort.no_devices: No supported A3xx air purifiers were found in this account. Pair a purifier in the Changhuxi app first.
abort.wrong_account: Sign in with the same account as the existing integration.

init.title: Air purifiers
init.description: Choose the devices to add. New devices are discovered when opening this screen.

error.cannot_connect: Could not refresh the device list. Please try again later.

abort.reauth_required: Your session has expired. Complete the sign-in repair first.
